scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include="dist/**/*.js" --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines=90 --functions=90 --branches=85 node --test test/*.test.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src test package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .github README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .github README.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
